permissions.desc: Fetch live Polymarket odds, price history and public Telegram channel digests, five-coin spot prices, Hyperliquid perpetuals, and send microphone audio to the Glance backend proxy for local transcription.
permissions.name: network

permissions.desc: Voice commands: tap, speak a command ("bitcoin price", "watch bitcoin", "morning brief"), and Glance carries it out. Audio is transcribed by a local Whisper model on the Glance server — no cloud ASR.
permissions.name: g2-microphone
